userPrompt:
You are an expert data extraction engine specializing in complex video game UIs. Your task is to extract the primary combat statistics for the OPPONENT (right side) using the following Region of Interest (ROI) coordinates to guide your OCR focus.

### REGION OF INTEREST (ROI) GUIDANCE:
1. OPPONENT NAME WINDOW (default white text):
   - Position: [X: 54%, Y: 7.4%]
   - Size: [Width: 32.2%, Height: 2.3%]
   - Expected Content: Text with potential special symbols (e.g., "+|R_ostr1ng+|+").

2. OPPONENT POWER WINDOW (white text):
   - Position: [X: 74%, Y: 14.6%]
   - Size: [Width: 18%, Height: 1.5%]
   - Expected Content: A large multi-digit number (e.g., "2069919").

### EXTRACTION RULES:
- name: Extract the exact string from the Name ROI. Include all symbols (+, |, _, etc.) and preserve case sensitivity.
- nameLatin: Provide a Latin transliteration. If already Latin, return the original string without any symbols.
- power: Extract the number from the Power ROI. Return as a single continuous positive integer (NO spaces or commas).
- language: Identify the language of the name text.

Return ONLY this JSON shape:

{
  "name": "<exact_name>",
  "nameLatin": "<transliteration>",
  "power": <integer>,
  "language": "<detected_language>"
}
